name: Sheraton 20, 2BDR
headline: The Hospitable 2BDR Apt. | 5 min from CAI Airport.
summary: The apartment features 2 bedrooms and 2 bathrooms, and a spacious colorful living room with a couch, a dining  table and a fully equipped kitchen with a Nespresso coffee machine and a kettle. Cooking utensils are also available. There is cable and smart TV to stream your favorite content along with fast and reliable Wifi.

description.Interaction:
We are more than happy to answer all of your questions . Guests can text and call anytime they need help and our team will be there in about 30 mins to solve any issue immediately.

At Xuru Stays, we’re committed to providing our guests the magical hospitality they deserve.
description.Neighborhood:
The neighborhood is packed with cafés and restaurants along Ankara street which is close to the apartment. 
This neighborhood is full of life with plenty of street food options (the apartment is quite and peaceful though) 

- Banks and other services are also within walking distance. 

- Sun City Mall and Cairo Complex are within 5 min walking distance. 
- Giza Pyramids is a 50 min drive
- Downtown Cairo is a 30 min drive 
- New Cairo is a 15 min drive
- Cairo International Airport is a 5 min drive.
description.Transit: All places are reachable by car and Uber but if you want take a walk it's not going to take you more than 5 minutes to reach any of the services around.
description.Notes:
Please note that additional unreported guests are not allowed to access or enter the property.
Only families and business travelers are allowed.

agreement:
Kindly note that a damage deposit of USD 150 (or the equivalent in EGP) is required. The payment is collected online as part of the reservation payment and will be reimbursed on the checkout day, provided no damages are incurred.
  • Smoking (including shisha) inside the unit is strictly not allowed. However it is allowed in the unit’s balcony (if applicable). A fine of $100 may be imposed in case of smoking indoors.
 • Partying, excessive noise and public alcohol drinking is not allowed. In case of violations, security will be notified and appropriate strict actions will be taken. 
 • Visitors are not allowed, only confirmed guests stated in the reservation will be granted entry. 
• Egyptian & Arab couples ONLY are required to provide proof of marriage according to Egyptian law. Guests are required to send their IDs or passports to the email (id@xurustays.com) or (id.elgouna@xurustays.com) as per the local regulations.
• El Gouna entry permits require 48 hours to be issued, in case guest IDs and passports are sent less than 48 hours before check in date, entry permits are subject to delay or may not be granted. 
 • Cancellation more than 30 days before the arrival date, we keep 10% of the total price of the stay.
 • Cancellation between 15 days and 30 days before the arrival date, we keep 50% of the total price of the stay. 
• Cancellation between 7 days and 15 days before the arrival date, we keep 75% of the total price of the stay.
• Less than 7 days, we keep 100% of the price of the stay
• Pets are not allowed, in case of violation, Xuru Stays has the right to cancel the reservation with no refund. 

Thank you for choosing our home for your Holiday.
We hope that you have a pleasant stay.

Xuru Stays

reviews.review: I was very impressed when I got into this apartment. Everything was new and working properly, the ACs in every room, the washing machine, the stove, the big smart TV, the fast internet connection, the big balcony, the two toilets, and the cleanliness. The apartment is located in a calm residential neighborhood under 10 minutes from the Cairo airport, sparing you the risk of missing a flight because of the unpredictable Cairo traffic. You have lots of fast food restaurants on a busier street 5 minutes on foot, including other handy amenities like grocery shops, ATM machines, cosmetic shops. Anytime we commanded an Uber ride to any part of Cairo, a driver was nearby ready to pick us up. My children and I loved the place. it is so functional and quiet, you wouldn't imagine that the apartment is near an airport. Even the lift is smooth, which is not the case for most Cairo buildings that age. l highly recommend this apartment. I give it 5 stars.

Great flat to stay at! Matches the photos and was very clean. The team is very responsive and helpful however the wifi was quite slow (all the working on certain occasions). Overall a good stay and would recommend it/come again!!❤️

The only concern was that the listing stated 3rd floor and the apartment ended up being on the 4th-so that caused massive confusion. Nonetheless-the host responded quickly and got someone to us that took us to the 4th floor apartment.  When I stated the TV apps weren’t responding, they sent someone asap.  
Those two things weren’t major, especially bc they were taken care of immediately.
We LOVED the stay!!! Extremely clean and comfy place-two beautiful and clean bathrooms!  The beds were extremely comfortable!!  
I would DEFINITELY recommend and plan on staying again!!  No need to look anywhere else :))

خلال زيارتي إلى مصر حجزت الشقة عبر التطبيق. كانت الشقة مرتبة ونظيفة وبمستوى جيد من التجهيز، وتضم مطبخًا ودورتي مياه وغرفتي نوم وبلكونه بإطلاله جانبيه ، وموقعها مناسب وقريب من الخدمات. واجهتني مشكلة أن السخان والتلفزيون كانا معطلين، فتواصلت مع فريق الإدارة وكانوا سريعين في الاستجابة؛ أرسلوا فنيًا ثم أوضحوا أن الأمر يحتاج صيانة إضافية في اليوم التالي، وعرضوا عليّ الانتقال إلى شقة بديلة من الشقق التي يديرونها. في اليوم التالي فضّلت الانتقال إلى شقة أخرى عبر التطبيق لدى بائع مختلف. أشكرهم على تعاونهم وسرعة متابعتهم وحرصهم على الحل، فكانت تجربتي بشكل عام جيدة من حيث التعامل والاستجابة.
